_comment: How unify.py fits each group. Clips not listed (new single activities) use ramp. Modes: ramp = first and last idle-pose frames each matched, linear in between; group = start/loop/end share corrections so loops stay seamless; first/last = one fit on that idle-pose frame; colour = pose-independent colour classes over the clip; colour-last = colour classes for the special pose, ramping to the idle-pose fit in the last segment.

groups.note: the petting hand is skin coloured
the umbrella is red and white
holds a console instead of pom-poms
